definition: Constraining a reasoning trace to labelled segments -- perception against inference, evidence against conclusion, phase identifiers -- so that different parts can be supervised, rewarded or read separately. Across 4 sources the argument for it is a credit-assignment one: with a single outcome signal the segments compete for credit, and giving each its own process reward and its own advantage term stops an update improving one from being cancelled by the other. Its measured value in that source is 63.90 for standard training with an unstructured trace against a higher figure for the structured version, with supervised fine-tuning alone at 55.18. Two other uses appear: enforcing named phases so a synthesised trace can be checked for clinical validity, and typing steps so that a compression search can operate on them. The archive's caution is the general one about trace structure -- a labelled segment is a constraint on the form of the output, and the faithfulness literature says the form need not correspond to what produced the answer.

evidence.note: Synthesizes Cognitive Behavioral Therapy dialogues using a CoT strategy grounded in CBT guidelines plus a resistance orchestrator that steers simulated patients away from sycophantic compliance.
evidence.title: ODRA: Synthesizing Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Sessions with Structured Chain-Of-Thought and Dynamic Patient Resistance

evidence.note: Separates hallucination into a reasoning failure and a knowledge failure, treats the first with a structured reflect-before-answering format and the second with a reward for abstaining when no sampled chain succeeds, and shows the two mechanisms are not interchangeable -- reflection alone never abstains, abstention alone never lowers the hallucination proxy.
evidence.title: REIN: Bridging the Gap between Reasoning and Reliability via Reflection and Abstention Alignment

evidence.note: Replaces a verbose natural-language rationale with two to six executable action tokens drawn from a fixed vocabulary, supervised automatically by pairing logged trajectories with scene context, so that driving-oriented reasoning fits inside a real-time control budget that verbose chain-of-thought exceeds by three to four times.
evidence.title: XCoT-VLA: Executable Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language-Action Driving

evidence.note: Splits a spatial-reasoning chain of thought into explicitly typed segments -- perception, including depth, and reasoning -- and gives each its own process reward and its own advantage term, so that the two do not compete for credit under a single outcome signal.
evidence.title: SCOUT: Unlocking Enhanced Spatial Reasoning via Structured Chain-of-Thought and Multi-Objective Process Reward

name: structured chain of thought
